title: International Geomagnetic Reference Field
text: 使用 International Geomagnetic Reference Field 计算地球磁场和长期变化，输入 4 路、输出 10 路；按 {Action for out-of-range input} 指定超出范围时的模块行为；{Generation} 指定 International Geomagnetic Reference Field generation、{Units} 指定单位 Metric、{Input decimal year} 指定所需年份、{Month} 指定 Input month、{Day} 指定 Input day、{Year} 指定 Input year、{Output secular variance} 指定 Secular variances，按实例取值。

params.name: Generation
params.values: International Geomagnetic Reference Field generation IGRF-14 (default) | IGRF-13 | IGRF-11 | IGRF-12

params.name: Month
params.values: Input month January (default) | February | March | April | May | June | July | August | September | October | November | December

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: 超出范围时的模块行为 None (default) | Warning | Error
